move: comparison curtain glides open, hesitates back, sweeps across, closes
how: A framed image pair: the after layer is clipped with clip-path inset(0 0 0 p%) and a handle line and knob track p across the frame width via an onUpdate apply(). The frame scales in from 0.92 with expo.out, labels drop in and a title rises from a mask. From 0.1D the curtain glides from p=100 to 28 with expo.inOut over 2.2s (knob swells to 1.12), at 0.37D hesitates back to 58 with power3.inOut, then at 0.55D sweeps to 4 with expo.inOut over 1.9s; the photo breathes from scale 1.06 to 1.0 linearly. At 0.86D it glides back to 100 to close the loop and the title and labels exit.
adapt: Swap the background image and the before/after CSS filters (or use two different images), the labels and title; the CSS-drawn room overlay can be removed. Keep the three-glide cadence (2.2s, 1.4s, 1.9s) and the expo.inOut eases.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .frame with .before, .after, .handle, .knob, labels and title, and defines apply() against el's .after and frame.clientWidth; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the pos proxy tweens (onUpdate apply) at fractions of D (1.0/10, 3.7/10, 5.5/10, 8.6/10). Scope document.querySelector calls to el.
caveats: uses document.querySelector for .after/.handle/.knob; must be scoped
clip-path is written via style in onUpdate, so it relies on the tween firing on seek
the same image is used for both sides, differing only by filter
